Upcoming books: Like I said, I'll keep writin' 'em. Colophon: All the rest. How to forfeit one of copyright's best labor policies (permalink) There's a seeming paradox to copyright. For 50 years (starting with the 1976 Copyright Act) legislatures have monotonically expanded copyright, so that today, copyright lasts longer, covers more works, restricts more activities, and provides for harsher penalties for infringement, all in the name of protecting artists.
